AUTHOR: Lopez-Marcano
TITLE: Automatic detection of fish and tracking of movement for ecology
REGION: Tweed River estuary, New South Wales, Australia
SPECIES: Yellowfin bream (Acanthopagrus australis) in a multispecies estuarine assemblage
DATA: Own action-camera footage: training videos May-Sep 2019 (8,700 annotated fish); movement test dataset Oct 2019 from a different location (76 video snippets, 169 bream); released on Zenodo
V_EV: 2.2 Object tracking: 'This environment suffers from frequent low visibility and currents that bring floating debris, presenting a relatively challenging scenario'
D2: Training data: random 90/10 train/validation of annotated frames; test: separate movement dataset collected one month later at a different location (76 videos)
D_EV: 2.2: 'by using movement data gathered one month after the training dataset was collected from a different location in the Tweed River estuary, Australia.'
R_EV: 2.1: 'we collected video footage of bream in the Tweed River estuary'; test data 'from a different location in the Tweed River estuary' (same campaign, same camera model)
C_EV: 2.1: 'We used a confidence threshold of 80%, meaning that we selected object detection outputs where the model was 80% or more confident'
E_EV: 2.3.3: 'we manually observed all the videos and determined the direction of movement for each fish ... compared the ground-truth output to the net movement direction'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (ResNet50) detector + MOSSE / Seq-NMS / SiamMask trackers
METR: mAP50, precision, recall, F1 (detection and tracking, counts of individuals); proportion of movement directions vs ground truth
NOTE: D/R: test set is a separate deployment one month later at a different location within the same estuary with the same camera model -> credited under D (사이트/서식지) and, per P2, R1 = N. C: single fixed 80% threshold, no sensitivity analysis; C_ALL = P applied from the policy note 'C1 = Y alone -> P' (the main C_ALL text requires threshold sensitivity for P, so a verifier might code N). C5 = 없음: tracker IoU>=30% continuation logic is ID management but duplicate counting across the camera array is only acknowledged as a limitation ('the array also resulted in repeated tracking of fish'), not handled. E: movement direction (behaviour) compared with manual reading of the same videos; no independent reference. V2 = Y (cameras at 2-3 m depth). Pretraining not stated (PRE NR).
